d: After Mitchell Starc comments, Pat Cummins is about to face the heat. Eight years after the Cape Town ball-tampering scandal, Australian cricket is still struggling to put the Sandpapergate controversy to rest. Usman Khawaja's revelations have brought the dressing-room divide back into focus, while Cricket Australia's decision to stand by its original investigation leaves important questions unanswered. Rupha Ramani examines the conflicting accounts, the missing 2018 investigation report and the challenge facing Pat Cummins as he attempts to close a chapter that refuses to stay shut.
